title: God's Concern in a Broken World

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: If a man marries a woman who becomes displeasing to him because he finds something indecent about her, and he writes her a certificate of divorce, gives it to her and sends her from his house, and if after she leaves his house she becomes the wife of another man, and her second husband dislikes her and writes her a certificate of divorce, gives it to her and sends her from his house, or if he dies. - Deut 24:1-3 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
This passage introduces a difficult subject, divorce. We must read it carefully. God is not commanding or encouraging divorce here, nor is He saying it is a good thing. Rather, He is regulating a painful reality that already existed in a fallen world, putting boundaries around it to bring some order and protection where sin had caused brokenness.

Jesus Himself explained this text. When asked about it, He said that Moses permitted divorce "because your hearts were hard," but that from the beginning it was not meant to be so (Matt 19:8). God's original design for marriage was lifelong union between one man and one woman. This law was a concession to human sinfulness, not an endorsement of it. It provided a measure of protection, especially for the woman, who received a certificate rather than simply being cast out with no standing.

This shows us a God who deals graciously and realistically with people in a broken world. He does not ignore the messiness of human sin, but works within it to limit harm and protect the vulnerable. Yet He always holds before us His good and beautiful design. If you have been touched by the pain of a broken marriage, know that God is not distant from your hurt; He meets us with grace in our brokenness, and in Christ there is healing and hope. How does it comfort you that God works graciously even amid our failures?

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. How does God's realism about a broken world comfort you?
2. Do you hold on to God's good design while receiving His grace?
3. Where do you need His healing in areas of brokenness?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You that You meet us with grace even in our brokenness. Help me honour Your good design while resting in Your healing mercy. Amen.
